answer: Before an agent may trade, it must clear the screen a rideshare driver faces: a Checkr background check, the report Uber and DoorDash order before a fare. Checkr traces the operator's Social Security number through criminal courts, driving records, and address history, taking 3 to 7 days and costing $25 to $100 per identity. A farmer minting fifty fake agents pays $1,250 to $5,000 and waits a week, only for the onyx court ledger to expose the false pigment in every invented record, while the jade-green clearance badge stays out of reach for each forged name.
